title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 te kompleksi Darling ne Ali dem 167 000
description_sq: hitet apartament i tipologjise 2+1+2 me post parkimi ne kompleksin “Darling”, i cili ndodhet ne rrugen Ali Demi. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7-te dhe organizimi tij eshte si me poshte: hyrja me korridor, salloni i ndenjes i lidhur me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dy dhima gjumi dhe dy tualete. Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti lokalizohet ne nje zone lehtesisht te aksesueshme prane Unazes se Madhe. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe shitet i mobiluar. Zona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE in the Darling complex in Ali dem 167,000
description_en: 2+1+2 typology apartment for sale with parking in the "Darling" complex, which is located on Ali Demi Street. The apartment is located on the 7th floor and its organization is as follows: entrance with corridor, living room connected to the kitchen corner and exit to the balcony, two bedrooms and two toilets. The building in which the apartment is located is located in an easily accessible area near the Great Ring Road. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and is sold furnished. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
